title: Directs the Oregon Criminal Justice Commission to study ways to improve the efficiency of procedures for setting aside convictions, and to provide the results of the study to the appropriate interim committees of the Legislative Assembly no later than December 31, 2026.
headline: SB 187 did not pass

claims.text: SB 187 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
